On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 9:42 AM soojin_lee@redwood.com wrote:
> Note: I've seen Exchange clients sometimes create duplicate entries when an external organizer sends an .ics plus an inline calendar attachment. If anyone at Acme notices duplicates or a permission error, please forward the screenshot (it helps us diagnose).

We tried to add the invite but our Exchange showed two events after accepting — one was labeled "(external organizer)" and clicking the Meet link opens a redirect page and then a 404. Attaching screenshot of the error (screenshot-join-error.png). Our IT team says some external .ics payloads include a second embedded URL that trips our security filter.

Can you resend as a single .ics created from your side and, if possible, attach the direct Zoom link as the primary join URL? If we can get that sorted I'd be happy to confirm Wed 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Roberta

Hi Roberta — looping in Connor and Marcus from Platform (they'll join the demo).

Thanks for the screenshot — this looks like the "dual-URL" issue where Google Meet and an embedded fallback sometimes both get written to the .ics and Exchange surfaces the secondary as a separate event. I regenerated a single, clean .ics that has the Zoom meeting as the primary join URL and removed the Meet entry. Please accept the new invite (redwood-fixed-invite.ics attached). Join details are below as well so it works even if your calendar skips the attachment.

NEW meeting

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example
Passcode: 482961

Attachments: redwood-fixed-invite.ics

Thanks — see you on Wed.
